insiders._note: Insiders buying (SEC Form 4). Uses watchlist.edgar_user_agent; empty = no EDGAR calls, the panel says so. Every key is described in markets/README.md.
insiders._transaction_codes: Form 4 table I codes kept. P = open-market or private purchase with own money. A (grant), M (option exercise), S (sale) etc. are left out on purpose.
insiders._roles: Which reporting-owner flags count: officer, director. 10% owners are not included unless also one of these.
insiders._us_exchanges: TradingView exchange prefixes treated as US-listed (only these are looked up on EDGAR).
insiders._ticker_replace: TradingView to SEC ticker spelling, e.g. BRK.B -> BRK-B.
insiders._rate_limit: SEC fair-access policy allows at most 10 requests per second; 0.15 s apart stays under it. max_requests_per_run bounds one refresh.
